kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتفرنس (form IIq)
# نَتَفَرْنَسُ (natafarnasu) /na.ta.far.na.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
# نَتَفَرْنَسَ (natafarnasa) /na.ta.far.na.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
# نَتَفَرْنَسْ (natafarnas) /na.ta.far.nas/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَفَرْنَسَ (tafarnasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
